svg.title: Two OpenPowerBox units linked wirelessly
svg.desc: The OpenPowerBox unit here powers the input computer and local HaLow unit from a shared supply. Commands cross the wireless link to a second HaLow unit and then to the Raspberry Pi and relay. The OpenPowerBox unit at the pump powers that radio, the Pi and the relay; the relay powers the barrel fountain. Green lines return telemetry toward the computer. Gold electrical power is local to each station.
